_comment: Injection sites as fractions of the figure box, for assets/figures/*.png.
The zone overlay is an SVG with viewBox='0 0 100 100' and
preserveAspectRatio='none', so x/rx are fractions of the figure WIDTH and
y/ry fractions of its HEIGHT. They are not interchangeable: the figures are
roughly 1:2.17, so rx 0.04 and ry 0.04 are very different distances.
One table serves both figures. The male and female art was drawn to the same
canvas proportions (478x1038 and 477x1036), and every zone was checked
against both; nothing needed a per-sex offset.
Coordinates were read off a printed coordinate grid and checked against the
silhouette's own alpha extents, not estimated. Regenerate the audit overlay

placement.quad: Middle third of the thigh, lateral aspect. The clinical landmark is the span from the greater trochanter (y 0.475 on this art) to the lateral femoral condyle (y 0.705); its middle third is y 0.552-0.628, which is what ry 0.038 about y 0.590 covers exactly. The zone sits on the lateral half of the thigh's width, not over the rectus femoris on the front of the leg.
placement.othigh: Upper outer thigh, above the vastus lateralis zone and further onto the front of the leg. Kept clear of the quad zone in y so a subcutaneous pinch site and an intramuscular site are never the same target.
placement.vg: Gluteus medius over the hip, at the iliac crest, above and lateral to gluteus maximus. On a posterior figure this is the highest and most lateral of the two gluteal zones.
placement.dg: Upper outer quadrant of the buttock, below the ventrogluteal zone. The two are adjacent in life and adjacent here, but their ellipses do not intersect.
placement.abd: Either side of the navel (midline x 0.498, navel y 0.405), clear of it. The flank zones sit further lateral and lower, on the oblique.
placement.calf: Medial head of gastrocnemius, the fuller and lower of the two bellies.
